home.title: Ikaze kuri {{app}}
home.tagline: Umuryango umwe wo gutaha i muhira no kuguma uri mutaraga.

area.comingSoon: Biraza. Aka gace ni ak'akanya ubu.

wellbeing.roughHelp: You are not alone. The crisis button above is always here — call or text 988, or 911 in an emergency.
wellbeing.locksHelp: Ushobora gufunga igikorwa kimwe icyumweru, ibyumweru bibiri, ukwezi kumwe cyangwa burundu. Buto y'ubutabazi, ubufasha bwo kugaruka, abagenzi b'umutekano no gusiba amakuru ntibigera bifungwa.

community.noPhone: Nimero za telefone ntizigere zigaragara mu butumwa hagati yacu.

support.resourcesNote: Legal aid, treatment and transit. This directory does not cover food or housing.
support.meetingsTitle: Inama z'intambwe cumi n'ebyiri no gukira

safety.relapseDraft: Draft — for review. Calm first steps for the first 24 hours after a slip will appear here once reviewed. You are not alone.
safety.safeContactsHelp: Gumana umuterankunga wawe cyangwa umugenzi wawe wizewe hafi.
safety.vaultHelp: Your documents are encrypted. Paid plan feature; no price has been set yet.
safety.wipeHelp: Ibi bisiba koko amakuru yawe, nta kugaruka.
safety.wipeConfirm: Ndabyumva ko ibi bizasiba koko amakuru yanje.

reentry.tipsTitle: Inama zivuye kuri ba bandi babikoze
reentry.tipsAnonymous: Inama ntizwi ba nyirazo. Nimero za telefone ntizigere zigaragara.
reentry.tipPlaceholder: Ni iki cyagufashije muri iyi ntambwe?
reentry.celebrationFirst: Intambwe ya mbere irarangiye — ikaze i muhira.
reentry.crisisStep: Bika izi nimero ubu. Ushobora no gukanda "Need help now" hejuru ya buri shusho.
reentry.resourceOnly: Ubuyobozi bw'ubutunzi gusa — Groundwork ntibutanga kandi ntiyifatanya n'umuntu uwo ari we wese.

steps.step2: Saba ikarita yawe ya Social Security
steps.step7: Find a safe place to stay (call 211 or local housing resources)
steps.step8: Find food for this week (call 211 or a local food pantry)
steps.step9: Reba impapuro zo gufungurwa n'amatariki ntarengwa
steps.step10: Emeza itariki ya check-in ya mbere n'amabwiriza
steps.step13: Fata telefone, email na interineti y'ubuntu
steps.step14: Put every court date and check-in on a calendar
steps.step15: Vugana na serivisi zo kugaruka zo hafi
steps.step17: Check your fines, fees and restitution
steps.step19: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it
steps.step23: Fata gahunda y'ubuzima bwo mu mutwe
steps.step27: Saba akazi ku bakoresha batanga amahirwe ya kabiri
steps.step29: Fungura konti ya banki ukore ingengo
steps.step31: Subirana n'umuryango, utunganye inkunga y'abana niba bikenewe
steps.step33: Shyiraho intego y'igihe kirekire wishimire iminsi yawe 90

work.paroleNote: Check your parole or probation conditions with your officer before applying.

journey.portfolioPrivate: Bwihariye kuva mbere. Sangiza gusa iyo ubihisemo.

venue.placeholder: Ahantu h'akanya — icyumba cy'isanduku y'ivu. Nta mafoto nyayo y'ahantu yatanzwe; aha si ho nyaho.

family.help: Umuryango ubona gusa icyo wahisemo gusangiza.

readAloud.title: Gusoma n'ijwi
readAloud.help: Gusoma n'ijwi gukoresha ijwi rya apareri yawe gusoma inyandiko.

phase3.resumeHelp: Kora resume yoroheje yanditse uhereye ku burambe bwawe.
phase3.headline: Umutwe
phase3.interviewHelp: Iyimenyereze ibisubizo. Umwigisha wawe aguha amanota n'inama imwe.
phase3.gigsHelp: Short local jobs. Check parole conditions with your officer. Phone numbers are never shown.
phase3.paidNote: Paid plan. No price has been set yet.
phase3.geoHelp: Abandi babona umujyi wawe gusa. Ahantu nyaho ntahabwo hasangizwa.
phase3.rideHelp: Saba urugendo. Nimero za telefone ntizigere zigaragara. Muhurire ahantu hahurira abantu.
phase3.partnersHelp: Amatsinda mato ya batatu bitaye ku bandi.
phase3.caption: Ibisobanuro by'ifoto
phase3.qaHelp: Baza utamenyekanye. Abanyamuryango bari imbere barasubiza.
phase3.merchHelp: Ibimenyetso bya kode gusa. Nta cyo hanze gisobanura icyo bivuze, nta matariki yacapishijwe.
phase3.shareHelp: Ikarita imwe ifite imibare y'iterambere ryawe.
phase3.archiveHelp: Funira ubutumwa bwawe. Bufunguka ku munsi w'ingenzi.
phase3.matchHelp: Uhagarariye wawe abanza avugana n'abandi bahagarariye. Gukundana kuzimye ubu. Ushobora kubona impamvu, gusaba kumenyekanisha no kongera kugerageza.
phase3.datingOff: Gukundana kuzimye kugeza hashyizweho itegeko ry'iminsi mike.
phase3.carpoolHelp: Reba hano mbere. Ku bushake, urwego rw'umujyi gusa: reba uge ujya mu nama yawe maze uhuze n'ubutumwa bwa app. Nta telefone, nta hantu nyaho.
phase3.groupsHelp: Amatsinda yo gukira, gufasha kugaruka, ukwizera n'umuryango hashingiwe umujyi n'igihe cy'inama. Amakuru y'urugero gusa — si urutonde nyarwo.
phase3.rideFallbackHelp: Bigaragara gusa iyo nta muntu uri ku kibaho ujya mu nama yawe. Bishyira icyifuzo gicungwa muri app — urwego rw'umujyi gusa, nta telefone.
phase3.noCarpoolMatch: Nta modoka zihuriye kuri iyi nama, bityo Nkeneye urugendo bigaragara nk'ingoboka.
phase3.familyRideHelp: Abashoferi bemewe gusa. Ubutumwa bwohererezwa bumwe bumwe n'itegereza ry'iminota 2; wemeza mbere y'ukurikira.
phase3.housingHelp: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.musicHelp: Indirimbo z'urugero gusa. Nta konti zo kumva umuziki. Igicurangizo kizimye mu masomo ya akademi.
phase3.musicOffAcademy: Umuziki uzimye igihe uri mu isomo.
phase3.shareWho: Ubu: wowe gusa. Gukora ihuza bituma uwari we wese ufite ihuza agisoma.
phase3.suggestHelp: Ibyasabwe gusa — nta cyo gitangazwa kugeza ubishyizeho.

crisisReply.onlyYou: Ni wowe gusa ushobora kubona ubu butumwa.

translationCheck.notice: Subiramo usuzume ihinduranyambo kugira ngo wemeze ko rihuye n'Icyongereza.
